source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My Agent system prompt is 8000 tokens and growing. It contains instructions for 20 different task types. How do I manage this?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate progressive-disclosure-skills, split instructions into skill files, replace with thin catalog in system prompt

test_cases.prompt: I have 150 MCP tools and the model keeps picking the wrong one. How do I organize them?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate progressive-disclosure-skills, organize tools into skill directories browsable by file-reading, expose only names at startup

test_cases.prompt: I want different customers to see different capabilities without maintaining separate system prompts. Can I modularize?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate progressive-disclosure-skills, deploy same catalog but conditionally load different skill files per customer

test_cases.prompt: My Agent has 5 tools and the system prompt is 500 tokens. Should I use skills?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate; the overhead is not justified for small stable capability sets

test_cases.prompt: How do I compress old conversation history to fit in the context window?
My Agent needs to load a skill but the description in the catalog is ambiguous -- two skills could match. What do I do?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Improve the skill descriptions to be more distinctive. The book notes the metacognition problem: if the model cannot tell which skill it needs, the catalog descriptions need refinement.
